Alex Sidorenko reported:
while experimenting with 'netem' we have found some strange behaviour. It
seemed that ingress delay as measured by 'ping' command shows up on some
hosts but not on others.
After some investigation I have found that the problem is that skbuff->tstamp
field value depends on whether there are any packet sniffers enabled. That
is:
- if any ptype_all handler is registered
column2: the tstamp field is as expected

column1: - if there are no ptype_all handlers
column2: the tstamp field does not show the delay""

column1: This patch prevents unnecessary update of tstamp in dev_queue_xmit_nit()
on ingress path (with act_mirred) adding a check
the fast path
column2: but only when sniffers etc. are active.

column1: Since netem at ingress seems to logically emulate a network before a host
tstamp is zeroed to trigger the update and pretend delays are from the
outside.
